supporting_operations.purpose: Energy-equation consistency term accompanying the Lorentz body force.
physics_notes: u . f_L = u . (J x B) is mechanical work by the Lorentz force per unit volume.
Under candidate scalar resistive Ohm's law eq-002 only, resistive dissipation per unit volume is |J|^2 / sigma; this is not the same as J . E in general.

Labeling J . E as 'Joule heating' is imprecise: J . E is the total electromagnetic power delivered to the fluid; its dissipative part under eq-002 is |J|^2 / sigma, and its mechanical-work part is u . (J x B).
Deferral of research by the user is not approval to leave the energy equation unchanged during a coupled run.
